title: 第1章 家族祭祀第2章 废柴陨落
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
天玄大陆。
八年后。
当年的事情随着苏鸿章的报仇而慢慢被众人所知晓，只不过他们所知道的，却是苏鸿成的版本——苏少卿的修为是苏鸿章强行提上去的，被玄天门的人发现后，当场被废，消息传到苏磊耳中，苏磊急火攻心，走火入魔而亡，待苏鸿章回了风城，因此发疯，趁着苏鸿成为刘纪吊唁，屠了苏家百余名下人，苏鸿成从刘家回来后，忍痛杀了苏鸿章，苏少卿也因此被整个风城，唾弃了三年有余，后来城主府一纸令下，责令不得歧视任何人，这才有所缓解。
当年苏磊留下的房屋，苏少卿和苏桃儿一直住着，苏鸿成每月都让人送来三枚护体丹，不过这是苏家护卫每月的俸禄，也不知是苏鸿成的嘲笑还是良心发现了，总之，为了苏桃儿，苏少卿打消了自杀的念头，每月靠着那护体丹续命。
风城中央，天宝阁门前集市。
“张叔，今天有没有好肉啊，给我来一斤。”一个衣着有些寒酸的女子提着一个菜篮子走过来。
“小桃姑娘，又来了。”张老头拿出一斤肉，递给苏桃儿。
“这块肉啊，我专门给你留的，别人要买我还不卖呢。”张叔笑道。
“好，谢谢张叔了。”苏桃儿数了数铜币，递给张叔。
“慢走啊，常来。”
“好，一定。”
天宝阁顶楼，一位蒙纱女子走出来，来到栏杆旁，低头看向远去的苏桃儿。
“这气息，好熟悉的感觉。”女子喃喃道。
远处，苏桃儿突然感觉心中一阵不安，四周环顾，远远的便看到天宝阁楼上有一蒙纱女子在看着自己。
二人远远的对视了一眼，随后蒙纱女子转身退了回去。
“听说天宝阁一年前来了个新阁主，难道就是她吗？”苏桃儿疑惑的转过身，向着城南小院走去。
天宝阁内，蒙纱女子坐在桌前，旁边是一位白发老人。
“他那有缘之剑卖出去了吗。”女子道。
“已经一个月了，毫无动静。”白发老人回道：“我看他就是存心捣乱，用不用把他撵走。”
“不用，他高价租地方卖剑，既然他出了钱，我们就没有赶他走的理由，况且，他卖剑的噱头也引来不少客人，先别管了。”女子道。

“是，小姐。”
城南小院。
“苏少卿，明天是家族祭祀，大少爷特地让我和你说一声，不要迟到。”苏明道。
“知道了，请回吧。”苏少卿拄着拐，从苏明面前走过。
“苏少卿，我劝你一句，给大少爷服个软，这样你也能好过一些啊。”苏明道。
“苏明，你回去告诉苏天，有本事，就让他弄死我。”苏少卿停下脚步道。
“苏少卿，看在我之前跟过你的份上，我真心劝你一次，识时务者为俊杰，你就服个软，是能掉块肉啊。”苏明道。
“没什么事你就回去吧。”苏少卿道。
“你！哼，不识好歹。”苏明愤怒的一挥袖，推门而去。
“哥，我回来了。”苏桃儿推开大门，恰巧遇到苏明，苏明登时便两眼放光。
“滚。”一颗石头从苏明耳边飞过。
苏明收起眼神，看了眼苏少卿。
“你也就还有先天觉醒的六条经脉，一个炼脉六段，少嚣张。”苏明说完，推开大门走了。
“哥。”
“回来了。”
“嗯。”苏桃儿把菜篮子放在院中的石桌上。
content_en:
Tianxuan Continent.
Eight years later.
What happened back then gradually became known to everyone as Su Hongzhang took revenge, but what they knew was Su Hongcheng's version - Su Shaoqing's cultivation was forcibly raised by Su Hongzhang. After being discovered by the people of Xuantianmen, he was abolished on the spot. The news reached Su Lei's ears. Su Lei was so angry that he went crazy and died. Su Hongzhang went crazy when he returned to Fengcheng. While Su Hong came to express condolences to Liu Ji, he massacred more than a hundred members of the Su family. After Su Hongcheng returned from the Liu family, he reluctantly killed Su Hongzhang. Su Shaoqing was despised by the entire Fengcheng for more than three years. Later, the city lord's palace issued an order not to discriminate against anyone, which relieved the situation.
Su Shaoqing and Su Tao'er had been living in the house left by Su Lei back then. Su Hongcheng had people send three body protection pills every month, but this was the monthly salary of the Su family's guards. I don't know whether it was Su Hongcheng's ridicule or his conscience. In short, for Su Tao'er, Su Shaoqing gave up the idea of ​​committing suicide and relied on the body protection pills every month to survive.
In the center of Fengcheng, there is a market in front of Tianbao Pavilion.
"Uncle Zhang, do you have any good meat today? Give me a pound." A woman in shabby clothes came over carrying a vegetable basket.
"Miss Xiao Tao, here we go again." Old man Zhang took out a pound of meat and handed it to Su Tao'er.
"This piece of meat is specially reserved for you. If others want to buy it, I won't sell it." Uncle Zhang said with a smile.
"Okay, thank you Uncle Zhang." Su Taoer counted the copper coins and handed them to Uncle Zhang.
"Walk slowly and come often."
"Okay, definitely."
On the top floor of Tianbao Pavilion, a veiled woman came out and came to the railing. She lowered her head and looked at Su Tao'er who was walking away.
"This breath feels so familiar." The woman murmured.
In the distance, Su Taoer suddenly felt uneasy in her heart. Looking around, she saw a veiled woman looking at her from a distance in Tianbao's attic.
The two looked at each other from a distance, and then the veiled woman turned around and retreated.
"I heard that Tianbao Pavilion had a new pavilion master a year ago. Could it be her?" Su Taoer turned around in confusion and walked towards the small courtyard in the south of the city.
In Tianbao Pavilion, a veiled woman sat at the table, next to an old man with white hair.
"Has his Fate Sword been sold?" the woman said.
"It's been a month, and there's been no movement." The white-haired old man replied, "I think he just wants to cause trouble, so there's no need to drive him away."
"No, he rents a place to sell swords at a high price. Since he paid for it, we have no reason to drive him away. Besides, his gimmick of selling swords also attracted a lot of customers, so don't worry about it for now." The woman said.
"Yes, miss."
Small courtyard in the south of the city.
"Su Shaoqing, tomorrow is the family sacrifice. The eldest young master specially asked me to tell you not to be late." Su Mingdao.
"I understand, please go back." Su Shaoqing walked past Su Ming on a crutch.
"Su Shaoqing, let me advise you to give in to the young master, so that you can feel better." Su Mingdao.
"Su Ming, go back and tell Su Tian that if he can, let him kill me." Su Shaoqing stopped and said.
"Su Shaoqing, for the sake of my previous relationship with you, I sincerely advise you once. Those who know the current affairs are heroes. Just give in. You will lose a piece of meat." Su Mingdao.
"If nothing happens, just go back." Su Shaoqing said.
"You! Hmph, you don't know what is good or bad." Su Ming waved his sleeve angrily and pushed the door open.
"Brother, I'm back." Su Taoer opened the door and happened to meet Su Ming, whose eyes suddenly lit up.
"Get lost." A stone flew past Su Ming's ear.
Su Ming put away his eyes and glanced at Su Shaoqing.
"You still have six meridians that are innately awakened, and one meridians are at the sixth level, so don't be so arrogant." After Su Ming finished speaking, he opened the door and left.
"Brother."
"Back."
"Yes." Su Taoer put the vegetable basket on the stone table in the courtyard.
